programme.desc: GOTTI follows infamous crime boss John Gotti's rise to become the “Teflon Don” of the Gambino Crime Family in New York City. Spanning three decades and recounted by his son John Jr., GOTTI examines Gotti's tumultuous life as her and his wife attempt to hold the family together...

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: She's The Man
programme.desc: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

programme.title: Tower of Evil
programme.desc: A group of experienced archeologists are searching for an old and mystic Phoenician treasure when they are surprised by a series of mysterious murders...Contains strong bloody violence.

programme.title: Women and Men Stories of Seduction
programme.desc: Three short tales, each featuring a man and a woman. The first one takes place in the 1940s, while the other two are set in the 1920s. In The Man in a Brooks Brothers Suit, a businessman showers a young Leftist woman with drinks on a train. They spend the night together, and he thinks he's fallen for her she seems to go along with it. In Dusk Before Fireworks, Kit, a lively flapper, visits Hoby's fancy apartment hoping for a night of romance, but constant phone break the mood. In Hills Like White Elephants, a couple traveling through Spain talk about her pregnancy: he wants things to remain the same, but she's unsure about what she wants.

programme.title: Second Chorus
programme.desc: When college students Danny O'Neill and Hank Taylor have to fend for themselves, the duo finds work with Artie Shaw's band and connects again with their former manager, Ellen Miller.

programme.title: A Family for the Holidays
programme.desc: This Christmas promises to be the best of Miranda Chester's life. She has returned to the beautiful New England town of Carlton Heath, where last year she found love with Ian McAndrick and she is among the family she never knew she had. A.K.A. Engaging Father Christmas.

programme.title: Memoirs Of An Invisible Man
programme.desc: When a government experiment goes awry it renders an innocent bystander invisible.

programme.title: Legend
programme.desc: Two young people are entangled in the ongoing battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Bee Season
programme.desc: An eleven-year-old girl from a dysfunctional family demonstrates a remarkable, almost mystical, gift for spelling when she wins district spelling bees and qualifies for the nationals.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: Daybreakers
programme.desc: As human blood becomes more scarce, vampires must search for new ways to satisfy their craving.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: A reporter wakes up in a morgue as a member of the undead, vowing revenge against the sect which put her there

programme.title: 30 Days of Night
programme.desc: During an annual month-long polar night, a small Alaskan town is attacked by a bloodthirsty gang of vampires.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: The officers work to find a bomber. But after catching him, they realize he has more targets set to explode.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy is attacked by an intruder at Traci's place and the Sex Crimes Unit steps in to take over the case.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As Jesus begins his journey out of the wilderness following forty days of fasting and praying, he struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis. This powerful drama depicting an imagined chapter from Jesus' life stars Golden Globe winner Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting, Star Wars franchise), Academy Award nominee Ciarn Hinds (Belfast, Game of Thrones), and Tye Sheridan (Mud, X-Men franchise).

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend (James Ransone) hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra (Mya Taylor), embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumour. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: How to Ruin the Holidays
programme.desc: A festive family caper starring Amber Nash (Archer, Mr. Robot) as a struggling comedian who reluctantly returns home for Christmas. Upon her arrival, she must not only deal with her eccentric and wildly dysfunctional family, but ultimately has a life-changing decision to make about her father and special-needs brother.

programme.title: Christmas Couple's Retreat
programme.desc: Three couples attend a retreat to strengthen their respective relationships under the guidance of a famed therapist. But as the holiday season unfolds, unexpected challenges arise when the therapist must confront some feelings of her own, and sparks fly when one couple's son unexpectedly falls for the charming retreat manager. Will this festive getaway reignite these couples' love, or will it lead them down an entirely new path?

programme.title: Dying of the Light
programme.desc: Exhilarating and original. From legendary director Paul Schrader (Raging Bull) and producer Nicolas Winding Refn (Drive). Nicolas Cage (Tokarev) delivers a stellar performance, alongside the late Anton Yelchin (Green Room). When a devastating illness threatens to end Evan's career in the CIA, he goes rogue to hunt down a terrorist who tortured him years ago on a mission gone awry.

programme.title: Let Her Out
programme.desc: Spine-tingling, this breakout body horror pays homage to director David Cronenberg. Waking up in hospital, bike courier Helen has suffered a traumatic head injury. But when she begins experiencing dark visions, blackouts and a strange presence around her, she knows she is in danger. Dark, disturbing and perfectly eerie, this horror will make you jump out of your skin.

programme.title: The Owners
programme.desc: One night in 1990s rural England, a retired couple finds their isolated house besieged by a gang of young criminals. The thieves think it will be easy to make them give up the secret of their safe. But they have no idea what nightmare they've gotten themselves into as they fight to escape the house alive.

programme.title: Lifechanger
programme.desc: From FrightFest Presents. A lean, mean, intense shapeshifter horror, with a chilling message suited to the complexity of the Me Too era. A mysterious “skin-walker” who steals the form, memories, and lives of his victims, leaving behind a withered husk of a corpse - is out on a blood-soaked mission to make things right with the woman he loves. A blend of body horror and serial killer thriller.

programme.title: Salt Beef and Rye
programme.desc: This vibrant documentary is inspired by the colourful characters who frequent the world famous Brick Lane. London's reputation as the cultural hub of the world can be attributed in part to its deep-rooted history and diverse communities. Salt Beef & Rye takes audiences on a tour through one of the city's most influential streets.

programme.title: Mythica: The Dark Spore
programme.desc: Certain to enthral fans of Game of Thrones -the second in this fantastical franchise is darker than ever. When a powerful relic is stolen, Marek faces a new sinister enemy, set on reclaiming the Darkspore for his master Szorlok. Now Marek and her friends must race through creature-infested lands, to an abandoned underground city, to save themselves from an imminent deadly evil.

programme.title: Stonewall
programme.desc: As Danny and his friends experience discrimination, endure atrocities and are repeatedly harassed by the police, we see a rage begin to build.

programme.title: Gook
programme.desc: Eli and Daniel, two Korean American brothers, own a struggling shoe store and have an unlikely friendship with Kamilla, a street wise 11-year-old African American girl. Kamilla ditches school, Eli stresses about the store, and Daniel tries to have a good time.

programme.title: East of the Mountains
programme.desc: A retired heart surgeon with terminal cancer sets out on a final journey with his dog to his childhood home. When plans unravel, he's pulled into an unexpected adventure, facing life with wit, resilience, and a renewed sense of purpose.

programme.title: Céline
programme.desc: Céline tells the unforgettable love story of one of the most compelling celebrity couples of all time and chronicles the rise to fame of the world's greatest pop superstar.

programme.title: Christmas on Honeysuckle Lane
programme.desc: After her parents' death, Emma returns home to celebrate Christmas for the last time with her siblings in the house they grew up in. Starring Alicia Witt (2018)

programme.title: Oh Christmas Tree
programme.desc: A family-run Christmas tree farm faces closure when a big city finance company threatens to buy it out in this family drama (2013)

programme.title: Once Upon a Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: (2018) Festive romance starring Aimee Teegarden. A life-saving transplant brings two strangers together - and as the holidays approach, a heartfelt connection turns into something more.

programme.title: Christmas on 5th Avenue
programme.desc: (2021) Christmas romance with Kathryn Davis. Christmas concierge Eva Jordan loves bringing festive joy to her clients. However, reclusive crime writer Lucas Blade might be her biggest challenge yet...

programme.title: Belle's Christmas Gift
programme.desc: (2024) Romance with Desiree Ross. Grieving her fiancé, Alesha visits her Caribbean grandmother and, while organising a charity event, discovers that love can be the sweetest holiday surprise.

programme.title: Bliss
programme.desc: In this quirky love story, a divorced man meets a woman who is living on the streets and is convinced that the world around them is just a simulation.

programme.title: Destination Wedding
programme.desc: Forced to tolerate each other for a few days, two cynical wedding guests strike an unexpected alliance.

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Art historian Madison “Maddie” TURNER, an expert in ancient artifacts and in deflecting unwanted male attention, travels halfway around the world to the Caribbeans in order to find the legendary "Lovers Stone".

programme.title: Sweet Autumn
programme.desc: Maggie, a successful entrepreneur, returns home for a will reading and discovers she's inherited half of her aunt's famed maple candy business. What she doesn't understand is why Aunt Dee's maple supplier, Dex, inherited the other half.

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: OLIVIA is picked to run the Christmas recital of The Nutcracker. When a video of Michael practising ballet with Lily goes viral, Olivia sees how much dance really means to the community. Will Olivia be able to save her dance studio with Michael's help?

programme.title: Christmas on Mistletoe Lake
programme.desc: Reilly finds herself in the magical town of Mistletoe Lake. She accepts the offer of Ray to stay in his boat, helping him renovate for the town's Christmas Harbor Festival. Reilly embarks on a journey to save the towns she fell in love with.

programme.title: Holiday Road Trip
programme.desc: Two feuding business associates fall for each other while escorting a celebrity dog on a Christmas promotional tour.

programme.title: A Christmas Princess
programme.desc: A prince from Europe comes to New York for a royal holiday dinner and falls in love with the chef that is planning the event.

programme.title: Belles Christmas Gift
programme.desc: Alesha hates Christmas so she reluctantly agrees to visit her Caribbean grandmother to help organize her annual Christmas charity function to save her clinic. When she arrives with her best friend, Alesha meets a handsome Brit, Garrett Graham.

programme.title: Christmas Oranges
programme.desc: Rose, an orphan, teaches the meaning of hope to all those around her. Share a slice of Christmas sweetened with friendship in this poignant story based on a classic holiday tale.

programme.title: Love On Harbor Island
programme.desc: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

programme.title: Lost in Love
programme.desc: Two tourists in Turkey get left behind by their tour bus after visiting an archaeological site. Without their belongings, they must make their way back to Istanbul, improvising along the way with meager means.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: A Christmas in Tennessee
programme.desc: Allison, her daughter, and her mother, run a bakery in a small mountain town.

programme.title: Holiday in Santa Fe
programme.desc: Casa de Milagro is a family-owned business that makes holiday ornaments and decor.

programme.title: Christmas in Mississippi
programme.desc: Holly Logan returns to Gulfport for a Christmas light show.

programme.title: A Christmas in Tennessee
programme.desc: Allison, her daughter, and her mother, run a bakery in a small mountain town.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Paintings made on canvasses possessed by a dead painter serve as a portal for him to enter and commit murders.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Sparks fly between an interior designer and a handsome pilot who finds homes for rescue dogs.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: A lawyer is riding high after putting a receiving a Not Guilty verdict for her client, but has to look over her shoulder when a woman she meets in a traffic accident is not all she appears to be.

programme.title: Baby Obsession
programme.desc: Years after losing her child under a sitter's watch Raquel seeks revenge upon learning the sitter is pregnant.

programme.title: Fatal Defense
programme.desc: A single mother signs up for self-defense classes from a handsome instructor. But he develops a frightening obsession with her and orchestrates an increasing deadly array of "tests" to see if she has truly learned from his lessons.

programme.title: Bad Teacher (2011)
programme.desc: A foul-mouthed seventh grade teacher who is dumped by her sugar daddy starts to pursue a colleague, which provokes conflict with the school's model teacher.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: A funeral ceremony turns into a debacle of misplaced cadavers and family secrets.

programme.title: Moms' Night Out
programme.desc: All Allyson and her friends want is a peaceful, grown-up evening of dinner and conversation... a long-needed moms' night out. But in order to enjoy high heels, adult conversation and food not served in a bag, they need their husbands to watch the kids for a few hours - what could go wrong? Moms' Night Out is an endearing, true-to-life family comedy.

programme.title: Are We There Yet? (2005)
programme.desc: Ice Cube plays Nick, a playboy bachelor and sports memorabilia collector who dates a divorced mother of two young kids who never like the men their mom dates. Things go awry when Nick offers to drive the kids from Portland to Vancouver where their mother is stuck for work.

programme.title: Somebody I Used To Know
programme.desc: On a trip to her hometown, workaholic Ally spends a whirlwind night with her ex-boyfriend Sean which makes her question all the past choices she's made. Ally decides she has to Sean back...which gets much more complicated when she meets his fiancé.

programme.title: Sunshine Cleaning
programme.desc: Once the high school cheerleading captain who dated the quarterback, Rose Lorkowski (Amy Adams) now finds herself a 30-something single mother working as a maid.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

programme.title: The Lonesome Trail
programme.desc: Johnny Rush, an Indian wars veteran, returns home to find his land seized by a cattle baron and his love engaged to the enemy. After a brutal fight leaves him unable to use his gun arm, Rush learns to wield a bow and arrow with deadly precision. Determined to reclaim his home and confront betrayal, he fights back against overwhelming odds.

programme.title: Apache Fury
programme.desc: A judge encounters a man (Frank Latimore) he once wronged after an Apache attack. The attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

programme.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
programme.desc: Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 46, 47
programme.desc: The Wild West adventures of Ben Cartwright and his sons as they run and defend their Nevada ranch while helping the surrounding community.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 48, 49
programme.desc: The Wild West adventures of Ben Cartwright and his sons as they run and defend their Nevada ranch while helping the surrounding community.

programme.title: Press for Time
programme.desc: When Norman Shields lands a job at the Tinmouth Times, he creates complete havoc.

programme.title: Trouble in the Air
programme.desc: This comedy centres on the aging butler to a poor country squire.

programme.title: Take My Life
programme.desc: A temperamental opera star finds out her husband is accused of murder she sets off to find the real killer.

programme.title: A Window in London
programme.desc: A man who witnesses a murder through the windows of a passing train tries to track down the killer.

programme.title: Yield to the Night
programme.desc: The powerful story of a young woman who falls madly in love with an impoverished pianist.

programme.title: Find the Lady
programme.desc: A model investigates the disappearance of her grandmother and is drawn into a web of kidnapping and murder.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: JANE GOT A GUN is the story of Jane Hammond, a young mother living in a secluded ranch on the vast New Mexico prairie. When her family's life is threatened by a conniving gang of outlaws led by the nefarious John Bishop (McGregor).

programme.title: A Murder in Oakland
programme.desc: Recently cleared of an embezzlement charge, Detective Williams (Marcus D Spencer) is handed a high-profile murder case while also forced to take on a new partner. Williams is trying to solve this case while also working to see if he can trust his partner.

programme.title: Superfast!
programme.desc: Undercover cop, Paul White joins Vin Serento's LA gang of illegal street racers as they plan to double cross LA's crime kingpin. The gang's outrageous wheel-spinning plan is as daring as it is ridiculous and will see them towing the whole damn restaurant, at crazy speeds, half way across the city.

programme.title: All the Names of God
programme.desc: The gripping story of an unsuspecting taxi driver who becomes a pawn in a dangerous game of survival as he is taken hostage after a terrorist attack.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Sydney's on the hunt for a Pirate's booty, but will a traitor force her to walk the plank?

programme.title: Women Want to Know
programme.desc: Sydney has found a temple with an idol of Ganesha and it is being filmed for TV, but they get trapped inside when the local rebels stumble onto them. Can Nigel and Karen help from USA?

programme.title: The Star of Nadir
programme.desc: An anonymous Sultan's wife Danielle dies in mysterious circumstances in the desert. However, she had called for Sydney to help. Sydney believes Danielle was searching for the Star of Nadir.

programme.title: Devil Doll
programme.desc: A guide leads Sydney and Nigel to an unusual, underground Aztec burial chamber. Instead of a body, they find a relic.

programme.title: Incognito
programme.desc: Retrieving a mythical lancet, Sydney and Nigel run into Nigel's look-alike just before his death. Nigel gets a cut from the lancet. Later, Cate persuades Nigel to impersonate the man.

programme.title: All Choked Up
programme.desc: Carson Inez, a collector, uses an ancient necklace to get Sydney to help her in raising Athena who will then help her conquer the world.

programme.title: Warlock of Nu Theta Phi
programme.desc: When Sydney's student Meg's roommate finds a witch's amulet, it hospitalizes Meg. Meg's boyfriend's fraternity brother races to get the amulet. What is he up to?

programme.title: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: While Sydney is lecturing about the Native Americans who faced a mysterious cataclysm 600 years earlier, a native brings her a relic from that era. What is its secret?

programme.title: The 5th Wave
programme.desc: When the human race is on the verge of extinction, one of the last survivors on earth, an extraordinary young woman, goes on a mission to track down her younger brother who was abducted by the extra-terrestial creatures colonizing earth.

programme.title: Ticking Clock
programme.desc: A reporter stumbles upon the journal of a murderer replete with plans to butcher specific people, and investigates on his own, finding that every trail leads to a 9-year-old orphan living in a group home.

programme.title: Lakeview Terrace
programme.desc: A young interracial couple move into their dream home and are increasingly harassed by their next-door neighbor, a tightly wound black LAPD officer. When the couple decides to fight back the feud turns deadly.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buster Williams
programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: Maya Oganyan, Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece's premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No. 8 ‘Pathétique' – this piano concerto is written in the key of C minor, which contributes to the work's stormy character. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger') by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Evgeny Kissin, Nikolai Demidenko, Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra & Antoni Wit
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Ballet Jörgen de Canada
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin. He previously wrote the scores for two of Canada's Ballet Jörgen's most popular ballets: The Velveteen Rabbit and The Emperor's New Clothes. Anastasia is both the tragic story of an innocent young girl and a modern myth: the exact events of that fateful summer of 1918 are shrouded in the mists of time. The ballet explores this lovable yet controversial main character's emotions, aspirations, and affections, as she is faced with a world in turmoil that undergoes an inevitable transformation. Anastasia is a sumptuous ballet performance, where costume and set design as well as the exquisite stage lighting reveal Canada's Ballet Jörgen's dedication to creative quality.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen
programme.desc: London Calling: Live in Hyde Park is a concert video of Bruce Springsteen & the E Street Band's performance during the Hard Rock Calling music festival in Hyde Park, London on June 28, 2009.

programme.title: Alabama and Friends
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama in a once in a lifetime concert event, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band. Experience timeless tunes 'Tennessee River', 'Love In The First Degree', 'I'm In A Hurry (And Don't Know Why)', 'My Home's In Alabama', and more.

programme.title: Carlos Santana
programme.desc: With a momentous career stretching back into the sixties, Santana has led the way in introducing initially Latin rhythms and styles and later influences from worldly cultures into the world of mainstream rock music. Along the way they have collected numerous awards, accrued multi-million album sales and garnered a string of top hit singles. Masterfully filmed in Montreux, Switzerland in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classic tracks from early hits such as "Jingo", "Evil Ways" and "Black Magic Woman" through to their later No.1 hits "Maria, Maria" and "Smooth". This is undoubtedly the have-to-have definitive Santana live concert. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Capilla de Boda, La
programme.desc: Sarah es una pintora sin inspiración, soltera, tiene mala suerte y quiere escapar de sus problemas. Decide visitar a su madre, y se involucra en salvar una iglesia local que está en peligro de cerrar.

programme.title: El Silencio de la Inocencia
programme.desc: La repentina desaparición de su esposa tras del nacimiento de su hijo obliga a Will a iniciar una frenética búsqueda por Europa para recuperar a su familia e intentar reconstruir su vida. A medida que el misterio detrás de las acciones de su esposa comienza a tomar una forma oscura y amenazante, Will está decidido a buscar la verdad, sin importar lo que cueste.

programme.title: Juego del Amor, El
programme.desc: Frances, la ex-esposa de Jake, conspira con sus hijos, para obligarlo a vender su amado equipo de baloncesto de Seattle. ¿Será que el juego sale de la cancha para encender chispas románticas?

programme.title: Los verdugos también mueren
programme.desc: El 27 de mayo de 1942 murió víctima de un atentado Reinhard Heydrich, jefe del gobierno nazi de Praga. El doctor Franz Svoboda, miembro de la Resistencia y autor material del atentado, se esconde en casa del profesor Novotny.

programme.title: Verano asesino
programme.desc: Elle, una bella y provocadora joven de 19 años, regresa a su pueblo natal en la Provenza acompañada de su madre y su padre adoptivo paralítico. El magnetismo sexual de la chica despierta la atracción de los hombres de la población, en especial de un mecánico llamado Pin Pon. Nadie puede sospechar que la actitud de Elle responde a un oscuro plan de venganza.

programme.title: Oro
programme.desc: El gerente de una mina de oro de Sudáfrica descubre un complot tramado por los propietarios de la mina y los banqueros de Londres para inundar la mina con el fin de frenar la producción de oro y, en consecuencia, manipular su precio en los mercados de valores.

programme.title: Intolerancia
programme.desc: Cuatro historias cada vez más interrelacionadas, ilustran la inhumanidad con la que el hombre ha tratado a sus semejantes.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: Irrational Man
programme.desc: Escrita y dirigida por Woody Allen. Un atormentado profesor de Filosofía (Joaquin Phoenix) encuentra las ganas de vivir cuando comete un acto existencial junto a su amiga y alumna (Emma Stone).

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: El experimento de un profesor de instituto para demostrar a sus alumnos cómo es la vida bajo una dictadura se descontrola terriblemente cuando forma una unidad social con vida propia.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal protagoniza este thriller de acción sobre un hombre que despierta en el cuerpo de otro hombre para descubrir que solo él tiene la capacidad de detener un ataque terrorista en un tren de cercanías.

programme.title: Palm Swings
programme.desc: Tras mudarse a Palm Springs, un matrimonio pone a prueba su amor al descubrir que sus vecinos son swingers.

programme.title: Tiene Que Ser Amor
programme.desc: Durante las fiestas de Navidad, tres hermanas deciden viajar para para replantearse su vida amorosa.

programme.title: Una Boya Feliz
programme.desc: En septiembre de 2010, Jordi Muns comenzó una aventura sin precedentes: navegar más de 1.300 km.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: Una decisión peligrosa
programme.desc: Tom (James Franco) y Anna durante varios años han gastado todos sus ahorros para poder tener hijos. En el apartamento vació de su vecino, la pareja se encuentra con $400.000. Sin embargo, su vecino fallecido, siempre había tenido chanchullos con malas compañías y deudas con la gente equivocada.

programme.title: Alta Mar
programme.desc: Tres parejas celebran un cumpleaños en un yate para pasar un lujoso fin de semana. Tras la noche todo parece en calma, pero nada más lejos de la realidad. Su pesadilla acaba de empezar.

programme.title: El mensajero
programme.desc: Brillante thriller entretenido y con mensaje sobre un padre (Dwayne Johnson) que, desesperado después de que su hijo sea acusado por error en un caso de tráfico de drogas, se ve obligado por la DEA a infiltrarse en un peligroso cártel donde deberá arriesgar su propia vida para salvar la de su hijo.

programme.title: Mine
programme.desc: Tras una misión fallida, un soldado (Armie Hammer) se encuentra perdido en el desierto. Expuesto a los elementos, tendrá que sobrevivir a los peligros que le acechan, a la vez que hacer frente a los efectos psicológicos de tan penosa situación.

programme.title: La casa de los espíritus
programme.desc: >A mediados del siglo XX en Chile, Esteban logra salir de la pobreza y convertirse en el exitoso dueño de un negocio. Sus maneras estrictas y tradicionales se oponen a las de los jóvenes revolucionarios, entre los cuales se encuentra el joven Pedro, quien está enamorado de su hija.

programme.title: Eisenstein en Guanajuato
programme.desc: 1931, tras el éxito mundial de su película "El Acorazado Potemkin", el director Sergei Eisenstein viaja a la ciudad de Guanajuato, Mejico, para rodar una nueva película. Rechazado por la implacable industria de Hollywood, Eisenstein se deja seducir por el encanto y la frescura de su nuevo destino.

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, narra como en la Irlanda de los años cincuenta la pequeña Evelyn y sus dos hermanos son separados y enviados a distintos orfanatos católicos, cuando un tribunal decide que su padre es incapaz de cuidar de ellos.

programme.title: Asuntos de familia
programme.desc: Nazaret en la actualidad: una pareja de ancianos vive cansada del ritmo de su rutina diaria. En el otro lado de la frontera, en Ramallah, su hijo desea seguir siendo un eterno soltero, su hija está a punto de dar a luz mientras el marido de esta consigue un papel en una película.

programme.title: Yo Quiero a Eva
programme.desc: Eva es invitada a festejar el cumpleaños de su vecino, sin sospechar que es una cita romántica.

programme.title: Yo Quiero a Eva
programme.desc: Eva es invitada a festejar el cumpleaños de su vecino, sin sospechar que es una cita romántica.

programme.title: Fresa y chocolate
programme.desc: David es un comunista convencido que estudia sociología en la Universidad de La Habana. Diego es un artista homosexual acosado por la homofobia del régimen castrista. A pesar de las abismales diferencias que los separan, entre ellos surge una profunda amistad.

programme.title: Happy together
programme.desc: Lai Yiu-Kai y Ho Po-Wing viven una apasionada relación. Viajan desde Hong Kong a Argentina para empezar de cero una nueva vida, pero la llegada al nuevo país parece transformar las cosas entre ellos y Ho, de repente, abandona a Lai. Un día Ho reaparece, pero nada es ya como antes.

programme.title: La partida
programme.desc: Dos chicos cubanos al borde de la marginalidad se enamoran y luchan por llevar una vida juntos.

programme.title: Deseando amar
programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: El Vestido De Compromiso
programme.desc: Cuando Claudia consigue llevar el afortunado vestido de dama de honor que ha hecho que todas sus amigas se casen, se da cuenta de que ha estado buscando el amor en los lugares equivocados.

programme.title: El espejo de los otros
programme.desc: Existe en Buenos Aires un lugar que pocos conocen, pero del que casi todo el mundo habla. Es Cenáculo, un restaurante único que se encuentra en las ruinas de una catedral gótica. Tiene únicamente una mesa y todas las noches ofrece una “última cena”. Nadie viene solo a disfrutar de la comida, los vinos y la música, los comensales que se sientan a cenar, transforman sus vidas. Por Cenáculo pasa el amor, la vida, la muerte, la codicia y la soledad.

programme.title: Howl (Aullido)
programme.desc: Joe es el revisor del último tren que sale de Londres durante una tormentosa noche. Súbitamente el vehículo frena de golpe y se detiene en lo más profundo del bosque. El conductor sale de la cabina para averiguar qué ha causado el incidente pero nunca vuelve. El pánico cunde entre los pasajeros cuando Joe encuentra al conductor horriblemente mutilado. Algo brutal y peligroso acecha en la oscuridad.

programme.title: Pie de página (Footnote) (V.O.)
programme.desc: Un padre y su hijo unidos por una gran rivalidad. Ambos, profesores excéntricos que se dedican en cuerpo y alma a su trabajo.

programme.title: Tres solteros y un biberón
programme.desc: Tres hombres solteros comparten un piso en París. Su vida feliz y tranquila se trastoca con la llegada de un paquete un tanto peculiar: un bebé. Parece que la criatura no es hija de ninguno de los tres y no saben quién es el padre. Mientras buscan a su madre deciden cuidar a la pequeña sin tener ni idea de cómo se cría a un bebé.

programme.title: Barbaque
programme.desc: Un carnicero mata por accidente a un activista vegano y vende su carne... con un éxito inesperado.

programme.title: A la de Tres
programme.desc: Val y Kevin deciden ayudarse a morir, pero antes tendrán un último día para cerrar asuntos pendientes.

programme.title: Cortes Peligrosos
programme.desc: Cuatro estilistas de Dublin se convierten en justicieras accidentales y héroes de la comunidad.

programme.title: El Poder de un Sueño
programme.desc: El joven Abe engaña a su tío alcohólico (Malkovich) para que compre un barco a un estafador.

programme.title: Yo Quiero a Eva
programme.desc: Eva es invitada a una cena para festejar el cumpleaños de su vecino, sin sospechar que se trata de una trampa de su familia porque quieren que sean novios, pero el plan se tambalea porque son muy metiches y se meten demasiado.

programme.title: Sex Monster
programme.desc: En Los Ángeles, el contratista Marty Barnes está emocionado por haber convencido a su reluctante esposa para participar en un menage-a-trois con otra mujer.

programme.title: Si fuéramos los últimos
programme.desc: A la deriva en su averiado transbordador espacial y con pocas esperanzas de ser rescatados, dos astronautas discuten si es mejor pasar los días que les quedan como amigos o algo más. El roce hace el cariño y las chispas cada vez van más en aumento…

programme.title: Pequeñas cosas dulces
programme.desc: Entre sus obligaciones como alcaldesa y su papel como maestra en el pequeño pueblo de Kerguen, los días de Alice están realmente ocupados. Emile, una explosiva sexagenaria que por fin ha decidido aprender a leer y escribir.

programme.title: Atraco En La Iglesia
programme.desc: Durell Washington y LeeJohn Jackson son dos amigos que se quieren como hermanos. También son un par de torpes delincuentes de poca monta. Cuando Durell se entera de que su ex-novia planea para mudarse a otro estado con su hijo, Durell Jr. - a menos que puedan obtener 17.000 dólares para pagar una deuda - a él y a LeeJohn se les ocurre un plan definitivo y desesperado: atracar la iglesia del barrio. Cuando el dúo se las apaña para irrumpir en la iglesia, descubre que alguien ha jugado. Para conseguir el dinero, Durell y LeeJohn se ven obligados a pasar la noche en presencia del Señor y sus seguidores, consiguiendo un botín mucho mayor de lo que esperaban.

programme.title: Magnolias de Acero
programme.desc: Seis mujeres sureñas se mantienen en pie gracias a su amistad y lealtad a través de los ciclos de la vida, el matrimonio, el Nacimiento y la Muerte.

programme.title: Aventuras En La Casa Branca
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes despistados se ven involucrados sin darse cuenta en el escándalo del Watergate que provocó la caída del gobierno de Nixon.

programme.title: Lilo, mi amigo el cocodrilo
programme.desc: Cuando la familia Primm se muda a la ciudad de Nueva York, su joven hijo Josh lucha por adaptarse a su nueva escuela y a sus nuevos amigos. Todo cambia cuando descubre a Lyle -un cocodrilo cantante al que le encantan los baños, el caviar y la buena música- viviendo en el ático de su nueva casa. Los dos se hacen amigos rápidamente, pero cuando la existencia de Lyle se ve amenazada por el malvado vecino Sr. Cascarrabias, los Primm deben unirse con el carismático dueño de Lyle, Héctor P. Valenti, para demostrar al mundo que la familia puede venir de los lugares más inesperados y que no hay nada malo en un gran cocodrilo cantante con una personalidad aún mayor.

programme.title: Entre Dios, el diablo y un arma
programme.desc: Un hombre accede al mapa de un tesoro y convence a un guía (Juan Chasquisdo) para que le acompañe en su búsqueda para recuperarlo. Ambos son perseguidos por bandidos.

programme.title: La quebrada del diablo
programme.desc: Al capitán Viktor Kaleb, desertor del ejército, se le ofrece el indulto y la reincorporación a la caballería si acepta liderar un grupo de fuerzas especiales en una incursión contra un bastión apache en México.

programme.title: La cárcel de Cananea
programme.desc: En este western mexicano, un agente de la ley sigue el rastro de un joven criminal. Con Pedro Armendáriz en el papel protagonista, la persecución se desarrolla en un entorno marcado por el peligro, la justicia y los conflictos propios del Viejo Oeste.

programme.title: La muerte pasa lista
programme.desc: Héroe enmascarado con látigo de toro. Película número 2 de 4.

programme.title: Los Super
programme.desc: Cristina, Belisario y Benito se convierten en guardianes de la justicia para combatir la delincuencia del barrio, y acaban enfrentándose a un malvado empresario que quiere sacar provecho político de un peligroso virus.

programme.title: Mi Multimillonario Secreto
programme.desc: La hilaridad sobreviene cuando un apuesto hombre de negocios va de incógnito por Nueva York como un "multimillonario sin techo".

programme.title: El robo del siglo
programme.desc: Ronald Christopher "Buster" Edwards, uno de los ladrones involucrados en "El gran robo del tren" de 1963.

programme.title: Lleno de ruido y dolor
programme.desc: Soria se une a dos bandidos para robar un banco de un pequeño pueblo de la Patagonia. Pronto se da cuenta de que ha cometido el mayor error de su vida cuando se ve obligado a matar a un inocente.

programme.title: El cadillac de Dolan
programme.desc: Un profesor de ciencia de una escuela de Las Vegas (Wes Bentley) intentará vengarse de los asesinos de su mujer (Emmanuelle Vaugier), una banda mafiosa liderada por el temible Jimmy Dolan (Christian Slater). Adaptación de la historia corta de Stephen King.

programme.title: Bienvenido a casa
programme.desc: Aún de luto por la muerte de su esposa, Bruno está irremediablemente apegado a la cabaña junto al mar que construyeron juntos. Cuando es desalojado por sus desalmados suegros, Bruno promete recuperarlo a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: Bienvenido a casa
programme.desc: Aún de luto por la muerte de su esposa, Bruno está irremediablemente apegado a la cabaña junto al mar que construyeron juntos. Cuando es desalojado por sus desalmados suegros, Bruno promete recuperarlo a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: El niño de barro
programme.desc: En 1912, en Buenos Aires, una serie de niños son asesinados de manera brutal. Mateo, un niño de diez años, oculta que en sus pesadillas es testigo de los crímenes, pero cuando la policía lo descubre, se convierte en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: ärtico
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes “quinquis” salen cada día despreocupadamente a la calle para buscarse la vida con lo que les salga. Pero además de sus cotidianos robos y trapicheos, algo les revuelve en su interior.

programme.title: El lute: Camina o revienta
programme.desc: Eleuterio Sánchez “El Lute” aprovecha un traslado para fugarse. Desde ese momento, será perseguido por la Guardia Civil.

programme.title: La Hermandad
programme.desc: En un apartado monasterio vive una hermandad de monjes benedictinos. Se ocupan de curar a Sara, una famosa escritora de novelas de terror y misterio, tras un grave accidente. Muy pronto Sara empieza a observar ciertos detalles que llaman su atención.

programme.title: Rosa Leigh
programme.desc: Sixty years ago an unimaginable tragedy struck the Ruth Lee Elementary School when a little girl named Rosa Leigh was killed along with her teacher and the school's janitor. Now, four paranormal investigators seek to debunk the claims which surround the abandoned school. However, they inadvertently release the darkness which dwells within the school.

programme.title: The Food of the Gods
programme.desc: A group of friends travel to a remote Canadian island to hunt, only to be attacked by giant killer animals which have populated the place.

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Paul Dean has created a deadly parasite that is now attached to his stomach. He and his female companion, Patricia Welles, must find a way to destroy it while also trying to avoid Ricus, his rednecks, and an evil government agent named Merchant.

programme.title: Billy The Kid Versus Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula travels to the American West, intent on making a beautiful ranch owner his next victim. Her fiance, outlaw Billy the Kid, finds out about it and rushes to save her.

programme.title: Speed Asesino
programme.desc: Dos mejores amigos utilizan aviones de alta tecnología construidos por ellos mismos para llevar droga de México a California y financiar así su estilo de vida en Hollywood.

programme.title: 12 Catástrofes
programme.desc: El día que Jacey cumple 18 años empiezan a suceder cosas extrañas: el agua se vuelve roja, tornados aparecen de la nada y punzantes lanzas de hielo caen del cielo. Pronto se da cuenta que ella es la única que tiene el poder de detener la fatalidad inminente. Usando un antiguo libro de profecías mayas y con la ayuda de su padre, Jacey buscará la manera de frenar los doce desastres que han activado la cuenta atrás para el fin del mundo.

programme.title: Love bite
programme.desc: La escuela ha terminado y el verano llega a la ciudad costera de Rainmouth. Jamie, un chico de 18 años, deberá empezar a trabajar en el negocio familiar junto a su madre. Aburrido y agobiado, Jamie fantasea con escapar de allí hasta que de repente aparece en el pueblo Juliana, una guapa, inteligente y sexy viajante americana de la que se enamora inmediatamente. Pero hay un recién llegado más siniestro en la ciudad: un hombre lobo se alimenta de vírgenes, y Rainmouth se convierte en un coto de caza.

programme.title: Asesino a Sueldo
programme.desc: Viktor creció en los suburbios de Rumanía y conoce el valor de la vida, lo que lo convierte en el asesino perfecto. Después de ser traicionado por aquellos que consideraba sus amigos, debe fingir su propia muerte y huir a Londres, donde se une a una nueva familia de gánsteres. Viktor es ahora más letal que nunca, un sicario de élite. Los secretos de su pasado se niegan a desaparecer, pero un encuentro con una belleza oscura le ofrece la oportunidad de una nueva vida.

programme.title: Jerarquía: Golpe en la cumbre
programme.desc: Dos hermanos adoptivos están a punto de llevar a cabo el atraco más arriesgado de sus vidas, un golpe que podría liberarlos para siempre. Pero perseguidos por una mafia despiadada y una policía dispuesta a todo para detenerlos, tendrán que elegir entre la huida, la lealtad… o la supervivencia.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de un despiadado jefe mafioso, un conductor que se da a la fuga después de un violento atraco deberá entregar a un joven miembro de la banda en una emboscada para ejecutarlo.

programme.title: El mensajero
programme.desc: Brillante thriller entretenido y con mensaje sobre un padre (Dwayne Johnson) que, desesperado después de que su hijo sea acusado por error en un caso de tráfico de drogas, se ve obligado por la DEA a infiltrarse en un peligroso cártel donde deberá arriesgar su propia vida para salvar la de su hijo.

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: En el nombre del rey
programme.desc: Película basada en el popular videojuego Dungeon Siege. Historia de corte medieval en la que un granjero de origen humilde consigue convertirse en un heroico y valeroso príncipe que tendrá que salvar su reino de un oscuro y tenebroso final.

programme.title: Bajo un sol abrasador
programme.desc: Un desvío en el desierto africano enfrenta a un científico y su familia a peligrosos traficantes de armas.

programme.title: The Night Never Sleeps
programme.desc: En el transcurso de una noche, Crímenes Callejeros de Nueva York da caza a los asesinos de uno de los suyos.

programme.title: Sharknado 5: Aletamiento Global
programme.desc: Con gran parte de América del Norte en ruinas, el resto del mundo se prepara para lo inevitable.

programme.title: Cuestión de honor
programme.desc: Un Ranger del Ejército se infiltra en una familia mafiosa haciéndose pasar por asesino a sueldo.

programme.title: Underworld: El Despertar
programme.desc: Cuando las fuerzas humanas descubren la existencia de los clanes Vampiro y Lycan, una guerra para erradicar ambas especies comienza. La vampira guerrera Selene lidera la batalla contra la humanidad.

programme.title: Driven
programme.desc: Un joven piloto exitoso está en medio de una temporada de campeonato y se está desmoronando. Llaman a un ex campeón de CART para que lo guíe.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: Passengers
programme.desc: Una nave espacial que viaja a un planeta-colonia lejano y transporta a miles de personas, tiene una avería en una de sus cámaras de sueño. Como resultado, un único pasajero se despierta 90 años antes de tiempo. Ante la perspectiva de envejecer y morir solo, finalmente decide despertar a un segundo pasajero.
